name: University of Milano-Bicocca
summary: Public university in northern Milan; two English bachelor's, in sustainability economics and applied physics, entered with the CISIA CEnT-S test.

ib.text: A secondary school diploma plus the CEnT-S entrance test. English B2 needed; a school diploma taught entirely in English exempts you from a certificate.

programmes.name: Economics and Science for Environmental Sustainability
programmes.about: Economics, management and science for sustainability: microeconomics, marketing and maths alongside energy economics, environmental law, ecosystems, Earth systems and climate change.
programmes.overview: The degree joins economics, management and natural science around one question: how societies can run on a sustainable footing. You take core courses in management, marketing, microeconomics and mathematics, then move into energy economics, market failures and regulation, and international environmental law. The science side covers biological resources, ecosystems and technosystems, and Earth systems and climate change, so you learn to read environmental problems from both an economic and a scientific angle. It is built for work on climate change and corporate responsibility.
programmes.ib: CEnT-S (CISIA English Test – Sciences); English B2.
programmes.selectionNote: Entry through the CEnT-S test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Physical Sciences for Innovative Technologies
programmes.about: Physics applied to technology, run jointly with the University of Pavia: green energy, quantum technologies and digital innovation, with hands-on labs and some online learning.
programmes.overview: You build a solid grounding in physics and then apply it to areas where technology is changing quickly: solutions for the green-energy transition, quantum technologies and digital innovation. Data analysis and laboratory techniques run through the course, so you gain practical experimental skills alongside theory. Teaching mixes on-campus sessions with online activity such as virtual study groups, forums and personal feedback from instructors. The degree is run jointly with the University of Pavia, with teaching based in Milan and Pavia, and it prepares you for research and technology-driven industry.
programmes.ib: Limited places; entry test CEnT-S, TOLC-S or English TOLC-I; English B2.
programmes.selectionNote: Limited places with an entry test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Admission for 2027-28 has not opened yet on apply.unimib.it; the 2026-27 intakes are closed.
Fees depend on your programme and the country your family's income comes from; a €150 deposit secures your place.
Bicocca also teaches Medicine and Surgery in English in Bergamo; ask Bicocca how first-year entry works.
